profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: I’m a software engineer specializing in Android with 15+ years building applications from high-scale consumer apps to custom B2B enterprise solutions. I’m passionate about designing durable, maintainable systems while contributing hands-on to complex features, guiding engineering standards, and turning product ideas into actionable technical roadmaps.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Founded Android team: Delivered solution with parity to iOS app (~8-year-old app, twice the team size) in ~1.5 years
- Owned end-to-end development for drone flight automation and photogrammetry app including UI, unit testing, services, build tools, and a custom real-time telemetry protocol.
- Responsible for architecture, roadmap, documentation, implementation, hiring, and mentorship.
- Influenced product direction and design by meeting with customers to prioritize features, and prototyping to ensure Material 3 coherence and platform consistency.
- Led adoption of Kotlin Multiplatform for shared logic, reducing duplicated code and aligning critical features.
- Raised team platform literacy, dev velocity and adherence to best practices through workshops, documentation, and onboarding.
- Streamlined testing and feedback by building “Hangar” app delivering ad-hoc Android builds for early feedback.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara County, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Technical lead for Android development of SoundHound app, contributing to demos and greenfield initiatives.
- Coordinated across iOS, web, backend, embedded, product, design, QA, and legal to align engineering with business goals.
- Led modernization of 10-year legacy codebase to Kotlin, Coroutine, Flow, Jetpack Compose, and automated testing; reducing crash rates, improving release cadence, and enabling faster feature delivery.
- Built high-impact features aligned business objectives: Shaped voice AI Platform, drove monetization with in-app purchases/advertising, improved adoption with social media sharing, and addressed legal concerns with CCPA & GDPR.
- Rearchitected content delivery: transitioned from server-side rendered system to a hybrid REST/GraphQL model, maintaining server-configured content priorities while enabling clients to make RESTful API calls, improving feature delivery speed and design flexibility.
positions.insights: Analytical Skills, Coaching & Mentoring and +5 skills

positions.title: Game Programmer (Intern)
positions.description:
- Created introduction/lobby gui to guide users through choosing their characters and creating a room
- Built system for character customization.
- Implemented system which creates textures at run-time to simplify the scene complexity by removing geometry based text.
- Developed a tool-tip like mechanism to display info about environment objects in matching gui space.
- Performed tweaks and bug fixes in various areas of already existing code.
